prompts.question: Is the company listed in the AEMPS - Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios registers of pharmaceutical manufacturers, medical devices or authorised cosmetic facilities?
prompts.why_it_matters: An AEMPS register entry is the Spanish authorisation needed to make or place medicines, medical devices or cosmetics on the market.

source.name: AEMPS - Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios

prompts.how_to_query: Open the AEMPS register search and enter the company name to look for a manufacturing, device or cosmetic facility entry.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in an AEMPS register with a facility or product authorisation.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the AEMPS registers by the exact company name returns no entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search does not load, or the company name is too generic to isolate one facility.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) published sanction resolutions or in its register of designated Data Protection Officers?
prompts.why_it_matters: AEPD resolutions are public proof of GDPR and LOPD breaches, and a DPO listing shows the company has a data protection officer of record.

source.name: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the AEPD site search with the full company name and review the resolutions and DPO records returned.
prompts.found_when: A resolution or DPO record naming the company is returned by the AEPD search.
prompts.not_found_when: The AEPD search returns no resolution and no DPO record naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The AEPD search engine fails, or the name is too common to attribute documents to this company.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company profile in the Alimarket sectoral directory covering food and beverage, FMCG, retail, packaging or logistics?
prompts.why_it_matters: An Alimarket profile shows the company is tracked as a real operator in its Spanish sector.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the full company name in the Alimarket company search and open any matching profile.
prompts.found_when: An Alimarket company profile for the company is returned with sector and business data.
prompts.not_found_when: The Alimarket company search returns no profile for the exact company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The results are paywalled or unreadable, or the name matches several unrelated firms.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member (asociado) of AMETIC, the Spanish association of digital technology, electronics and telecommunications companies?
prompts.why_it_matters: An AMETIC listing shows the company is recognised inside Spain's digital technology industry association.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the AMETIC associates page for the exact company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the AMETIC list of associated companies.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the AMETIC associates list returns no company of that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The associates list does not load or cannot be filtered by name.

prompts.question: Does the company have an Axesor company report showing commercial registry filings, financial statements or legal proceedings?
prompts.why_it_matters: An Axesor report gives a third-party view of filings, accounts and litigation the company may not disclose itself.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Axesor for the exact company name and open the matching company report.
prompts.found_when: An Axesor report page exists for the company with registry, financial or legal data.
prompts.not_found_when: The Axesor search returns no report for the exact company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The report sits behind a paywall or the search returns only same-name companies.

prompts.question: Is the company entered in the Banco de España (BdE) - Registro de Entidades as an authorised credit institution, payment institution, electronic money institution or currency exchange operator?
prompts.why_it_matters: Lending, payment or currency services in Spain require an entry in the Banco de España register of entities.

source.name: Banco de España (BdE) - Registro de Entidades

prompts.how_to_query: Search the Banco de España register of entities by the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the register with a licence category and registration code.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the register by the exact name returns no entity.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search does not respond or the name is too common to isolate one entity.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME) filings, and do those filings show any capital change, director change, liquidation or dissolution?
prompts.why_it_matters: BORME notices are the official Spanish record of incorporations, capital changes, insolvency and dissolutions.
prompts.how_to_query: Search BORME by the registered company name in the title field and read the notices returned.
prompts.found_when: BORME notices naming the company are returned with the registry events listed.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean BORME name search returns no notice for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The BORME search fails or the name returns many unrelated companies.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Cámara de Comercio de España chamber business census (censo.camara.es)?
prompts.why_it_matters: The chamber census confirms the company is a registered Spanish trading firm recognised by the chambers of commerce.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the chamber census search form and submit the query.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the census results with chamber or location data.
prompts.not_found_when: The census search returns no record for the exact company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The census form does not submit or returns an unreadable or error page.

prompts.question: Is the company listed among the member companies (empresas asociadas) of the Confederación Española de Organizaciones Empresariales (CEOE)?
prompts.why_it_matters: CEOE membership signals standing with Spain's main employers confederation.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the CEOE list of current member companies for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears in the CEOE current member company list.
prompts.not_found_when: The member list is complete and contains no company of that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list cannot be reached or is paginated beyond what can be read.

prompts.question: Does the company have a profile or news coverage in the Cinco Días company directory and archive?
prompts.why_it_matters: Press coverage shows how the company is reported in Spanish financial media.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Cinco Días company directory for the full company name and open any company page returned.
prompts.found_when: A Cinco Días company page or article naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no company page and no article for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search is paywalled or blocked, or the name matches several unrelated firms.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Citiservi local business directory with a trading address in Spain?
prompts.why_it_matters: A directory entry confirms a reachable operating location and the contact details published for it.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Citiservi with the full company name and check any matching business listing.
prompts.found_when: A Citiservi listing shows the company with an address, phone or opening times.
prompts.not_found_when: The Citiservi search returns no listing for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only unrelated same-name businesses or the page is unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC) decisions or proceedings as a party to an antitrust, merger or regulated-sector case?
prompts.why_it_matters: CNMC files show competition sanctions or merger reviews that affect the company's standing.

source.name: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the CNMC site for the company name and read the decisions and case files returned.
prompts.found_when: A CNMC decision, sanction or notified merger naming the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: The CNMC search returns no case or decision naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search fails or the name returns too many unrelated mentions.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded in the Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV) public registers of authorised entities, or listed in its warnings list of unauthorised financial operators?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only CNMV-registered firms may offer investment services in Spain, and a warnings entry marks an unauthorised operator.

source.name: Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the CNMV entity consultations by company name and check both the registers and the warnings list.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in a CNMV register entry or in a CNMV warning notice.
prompts.not_found_when: Clean searches of the CNMV registers and warnings list return no record of the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The consultation pages fail to load or the name is too generic to match one entity.

prompts.question: Does the company appear as a bidder or awardee in Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (PLACSP) tender records?
prompts.why_it_matters: Public tender records show awarded contracts, tender values and any joint venture (UTE) formations.

source.name: Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (PLACSP)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the PLACSP tender search with the exact company name and review the contracts tendered or awarded.
prompts.found_when: Tender or award documents naming the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean PLACSP search by the exact name returns no tender or award record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The tender search times out or the name matches many unrelated bidders.

prompts.question: Does the company have a clinic or practice profile with patient reviews on Doctoralia España?
prompts.why_it_matters: Patient ratings and practice verification show how a healthcare provider is publicly reviewed.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Doctoralia with the clinic or practice name and open the matching profile.
prompts.found_when: A Doctoralia profile exists for the practice with reviews or verification details.
prompts.not_found_when: The Doctoralia search returns no profile for the practice name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile exists but carries no reviews, or the name matches many unrelated clinics.

prompts.question: Is the company named in EjePrime news coverage of the Spanish real estate and property investment sector?
prompts.why_it_matters: Real estate press coverage shows the company's visibility and deal activity in the property market.
prompts.how_to_query: Search EjePrime with the company name and review the articles returned.
prompts.found_when: One or more EjePrime articles name the company in the headline or summary.
prompts.not_found_when: The EjePrime search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page fails to load or the name returns only unrelated mentions.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company page or news coverage on El Economista?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage and a company page show the financial performance and corporate events reported about the company.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the El Economista company page for the company name and read what is returned.
prompts.found_when: An El Economista company page or article naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: No company page and no article is returned for the exact name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page does not load or the name matches several unrelated companies.

prompts.question: Is the company profiled in the El Referente startup directory or covered for funding rounds and investment?
prompts.why_it_matters: Startup press profiles show the funding, investors and traction that back the company's claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search El Referente for the company name and open any startup profile or funding article.
prompts.found_when: An El Referente profile or article names the company with startup or funding details.
prompts.not_found_when: The El Referente search returns no profile and no article for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory page is missing or the name is too generic to match one startup.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the ENAC - Entidad Nacional de Acreditación directory of accredited testing laboratories, inspection bodies or certification entities?
prompts.why_it_matters: ENAC accreditation is the credential behind any claim of accredited testing, inspection or certification.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the ENAC accredited-entity search, enter the company name and review the entries.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the ENAC accredited entities directory with a scope of accreditation.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean ENAC search by the exact name returns no accredited entity.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The accreditation search does not load or the name matches several entities.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Expansión company database or in its corporate news coverage?
prompts.why_it_matters: Expansión reports governance, deals and litigation that shape the company's public standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Expansión company finder with the exact company name and open the company record.
prompts.found_when: An Expansión company record or an article naming the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: The company finder returns no record and no article names the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company finder is unavailable or the name returns many similar companies.

prompts.question: Does the company have a professional profile with client reviews on Habitissimo?
prompts.why_it_matters: Client reviews and a work portfolio show the quality of the work the company has delivered.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the Habitissimo professional listings for the company name and open its profile.
prompts.found_when: A Habitissimo profile exists for the company with reviews or a work portfolio.
prompts.not_found_when: The Habitissimo listings return no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listing carries no reviews or the listings show only unrelated tradespeople.

prompts.question: Does the company have an Infoempresa profile showing its directors, capital changes and deposited annual accounts?
prompts.why_it_matters: Filed accounts and director records let a researcher test what the company says about its size and ownership.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Infoempresa by the exact company name and open the company profile page.
prompts.found_when: An Infoempresa profile exists for the company with director, capital or accounts data.
prompts.not_found_when: The Infoempresa search returns no profile for the exact name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile is partly paywalled or the name matches several companies.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Base de Datos Nacional de Subvenciones (BDNS) as a recipient of public subsidies, grants or EU funding?
prompts.why_it_matters: Subsidy records show public funding actually received, which can be compared with grants the company claims.

source.name: Base de Datos Nacional de Subvenciones (BDNS)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the BDNS third-party subsidy records with the exact company or trade name.
prompts.found_when: Subsidy records naming the company as beneficiary are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean BDNS search by the exact name returns no subsidy record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The BDNS search endpoint fails or the name is too common to isolate the beneficiary.

prompts.question: Does the company appear as an employer with job adverts on JobToday España?
prompts.why_it_matters: Active adverts show the company is hiring and where its operational sites are.
prompts.how_to_query: Search JobToday by the company name with a Spanish location and look for adverts from that employer.
prompts.found_when: JobToday lists one or more adverts posted by the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The JobToday search returns no advert from the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search needs a location filter that is unknown, or no readable employer names are returned.

prompts.question: Is the company named as a party in judgments published in the CENDOJ - Buscador de Jurisprudencia (Consejo General del Poder Judicial)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Published court judgments reveal the commercial, labour or criminal litigation the company is involved in.

source.name: CENDOJ - Buscador de Jurisprudencia (Consejo General del Poder Judicial)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the CENDOJ jurisprudence finder with the company name in quotes.
prompts.found_when: Judgments naming the company as a party are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the database returns no judgment naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns too many generic mentions or the database does not respond.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the QDQ business directory with its trading locations and service listings?
prompts.why_it_matters: Directory entries show published addresses and services that can be checked against the company's own claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search QDQ with the full company name and open any matching company listing.
prompts.found_when: A QDQ listing shows the company with a location or service summary.
prompts.not_found_when: The QDQ search returns no listing for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only similar names or the listing cannot be read.

prompts.question: Does the company have user reviews, discussions or complaints on the Rankia financial community forum?
prompts.why_it_matters: Forum complaints and reviews show how customers actually experience the company's products.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Rankia with the company name and read the threads and reviews returned.
prompts.found_when: Rankia threads, reviews or complaints naming the company are found.

prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only unrelated market chatter or the forum pages are unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Ranking de Empresas de El Economista with a sales turnover figure for its province and CNAE sector?

prompts.found_when: A ranking page shows the company with turnover or with province and sector data.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of SpainCap, the Spanish association for venture capital, growth equity and private equity?

prompts.question: Does the company have a profile on Startupxplore showing its funding history and investors?

prompts.found_when: A Startupxplore profile exists for the company with funding or investor data.
prompts.not_found_when: The Startupxplore search returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only similar names or the profile is unreadable.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member company of Tech Barcelona?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership shows the company belongs to Barcelona's recognised digital and tech ecosystem.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Tech Barcelona company directory for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the Tech Barcelona company listing with a member profile.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the company directory returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search does not respond or the name matches several companies.
